verdict.rationale: Firebase Authentication SDK and FirebaseUI provide drop-in support for email/password sign-in plus federated OAuth providers (Google, Facebook, Twitter, GitHub) with minimal setup, plus built-in password reset handling; community evidence corroborates fast, easy auth integration ('5 hrs' to add real-time features, praise for developer experience and auth/rules separation). Missing for 10: no hands-on timed walkthrough proving 'minutes' claim and no independent benchmark of setup speed beyond anecdotal community praise.
